Cline: which KYA replays were tested

Replays tested on Cline

No replay has run on Cline. All 51 replays ran on Claude Code only, so this page makes no claim about Cline.

What the Cline setup page says about coverage

Cline's MCP coverage is the weakest of the wired hosts: the extension decides per-tool whether a call goes through MCP, and autoApprove can bypass the human checkpoint entirely. Keep autoApprove empty, and treat anything Cline does outside MCP as ungated.

Source: the Cline recipe.

Install

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
